name: @katanakit/ui
description: Katana UI foundations — framework-agnostic components styled with the vendored KatanaKit SCSS framework.

scripts.build: tsc6 -p tsconfig.json && sass ../../scss/main.scss dist/base.css --no-source-map --style=compressed && sass src/styles/index.scss dist/components.css --no-source-map --style=compressed --load-path=../.. && node scripts/concat-css.mjs
